AEGIS_BOSS.name: Vaelor, the Aegis Colossus
AEGIS_BOSS.desc: The guardian of the peaks raises an Aegis that absorbs damage. Its beam only fires while the Aegis holds – break it!

naturesHealing.name: Nature's Healing
naturesHealing.desc: Every 5th round, half of all debuffs on heroes and enemies are cleansed.

verdantBloom.name: Verdant Bloom
verdantBloom.desc: All healing is 25% more effective – for heroes and enemies.

overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
overgrowth.desc: At the start of every fight, one random hero and one random enemy are Overgrown: +25% damage and Block.

bloodMoon.name: Blood Moon
bloodMoon.desc: Enemies heal for 15% of the damage they deal to heroes. Heroes do not heal from it.

restlessDead.name: Restless Dead
restlessDead.desc: In every fight, the first enemy that falls rises again with 30% HP. Heroes do not rise.

witchingHour.name: Witching Hour
witchingHour.desc: Every 4th round, all heroes and enemies deal +2 damage per hit for the rest of the fight.

stoneskin.name: Stoneskin
stoneskin.desc: At the start of every round, every hero and every enemy gains 3 Block.

rockslide.name: Rockslide
rockslide.desc: Every 3rd round, falling rocks deal 5 damage to every hero and every enemy.

ironVeins.name: Iron Veins
ironVeins.desc: All Block gained is 25% higher – for heroes and enemies.

scorchingSun.name: Scorching Sun
scorchingSun.desc: At the start of every round, every hero and every enemy gains 1 Burn.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.desc: Every attack hit has a 15% chance to miss – for heroes and enemies.

shiftingSands.name: Shifting Sands
shiftingSands.desc: At the start of every round, one random hero and one random enemy become Weak (1 turn).

music.__fn: function music(name){ A.want = name; if(A.ctx) start(name); }

resume.__fn: function resume(){ init(); if(A.ctx && A.ctx.state === 'suspended') A.ctx.resume(); }

songLength.__fn: function songLength(name){ const s = SONGS[name]; return compile(s).length * s.beats * 60 / s.bpm; }

morrgan.name: Morrgan the Shapeshifter
morrgan.desc: The druid of the raging woods starts as a Wolf. After a number of cards played by your team (more heroes: more cards) he interrupts: your turn ends, he does his shown action and then transforms – Bear (Block + heals 15%), Hawk (gains Strength) or Serpent (Poison on all heroes). Each transform is stronger than the last!

vaelor.name: Vaelor, the Aegis Colossus
vaelor.desc: The guardian of the peaks raises an Aegis that absorbs damage. Its beam only fires while the Aegis holds – break it!

khepri.name: Khepri, the Sun Devourer
khepri.desc: A colossal scarab that swallowed the sun. At 2/3 HP it burrows and calls its brood, at 1/3 HP the eclipse begins.

thornwood.name: Elder Thornwood
thornwood.desc: An ancient tree. Thorns 3 – and its bark keeps growing spikes.

ai.__fn: e => [{atk:'front', dmg:16, name:'Root Smash'}, {atk:'aoe', dmg:6, name:'Thorn Barrage'}, {block:18, thornsUp:1, name:'Barkskin'}][(e.turn - 1) % 3]

bloodbloom.name: Bloodbloom Queen
bloodbloom.desc: Calls Sprouts, heals her court and spreads poisonous pollen.

briarblades.name: Briarblade Twins
briarblades.desc: Two vine duelists. When one falls, the other flies into a rage.

ai.__fn: e => [{atk:'pierce', dmg:10, name:'Thorn Lunge'}, {atk:'front', dmg:13, name:'Cross Cut'}, {block:10, strength:1, name:'Vine Parry'}][(e.turn - 1) % 3]
e => [{atk:'aoe', dmg:5, name:'Whirling Thorns'}, {atk:'back', dmg:11, name:'Backstab'}, {atk:'normal', dmg:7, poison:2, name:'Venom Thorn'}][(e.turn - 1) % 3]

bramblegolem.name: Bramble Golem
bramblegolem.desc: A walking thicket. Thorns 2, regrows its bark.

ai.__fn: e => [{atk:'front', dmg:14, taunt:1, name:'Thorn Hug'}, {atk:'splash', dmg:8, name:'Bramble Burst'}, {healSelf:12, block:8, cleanse:1, name:'Regrowth'}][(e.turn - 1) % 3]

vampirelord.name: Vampire Lord
vampirelord.desc: Heals from all damage it deals and calls bats.

ai.__fn:
e => { if(e.turn % 4 === 3 && alive().length < 5) return {summon:'nightbat', block:10, name:'Bat Swarm'};
      return e.turn % 2 ? {atk:'normal', dmg:13, name:'Drain Bite'} : {atk:'aoe', dmg:4, hits:3, name:'Blood Feast'}; }

lichking.name: Lich King
lichking.desc: Curses your decks with Hex and strikes the weakest link.

ai.__fn: e => [{hex:2, block:9, name:'Curse of Ages'}, {atk:'back', dmg:15, name:'Soul Spear'}, {atk:'aoe', dmg:7, weak:1, name:'Frost Nova'}][(e.turn - 1) % 3]

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.desc: Raises the dead. Kill him and his minions flee.

phantomduel.name: Phantom Duelist
phantomduel.desc: Phases in and out (Intangible every other round). Lightning-fast thrusts.

ai.__fn: e => [{atk:'pierce', dmg:15, name:'Lunge'}, {atk:'normal', dmg:5, hits:3, name:'Flurry'}, {block:12, atk:'back', dmg:7, name:'Riposte'}][(e.turn - 1) % 3]

juggernaut.name: Iron Juggernaut
juggernaut.desc: A dwarven war machine. Crushes the front line.

ai.__fn: e => [{atk:'front', dmg:18, name:'Steamroll'}, {block:14, atk:'normal', dmg:7, name:'Grind'}, {atk:'pierce', dmg:10, brittle:1, name:'Piston Punch'}][e.turn % 3]

granitetitan.name: Granite Titan
granitetitan.desc: Armored (every hit deals 3 less damage). Shakes the whole mountain.

ai.__fn: e => [{atk:'aoe', dmg:7, name:'Earthquake'}, {atk:'front', dmg:16, name:'Titan Fist'}, {block:16, bulwark:30, name:'Stone Skin'}][(e.turn - 1) % 3]

dwarfthane.name: Dwarf Thane
dwarfthane.desc: Rallies his clan with the war horn and calls stone golems.

ai.__fn:
e => { if(e.turn % 4 === 1 && alive().length < 5) return {summon:'pebble', rallyStr:1, name:'War Horn'};
      return e.turn % 2 ? {atk:'front', dmg:15, name:'Hammerfall'} : {atk:'pierce', dmg:11, blockAllies:6, name:'Shield Throw'}; }

runeshaman.name: Storm Rune-Shaman
runeshaman.desc: Gathers a storm for two rounds – then unleashes it.

ai.__fn: e => e.turn % 3 === 0 ? {atk:'aoe', dmg:6, hits:4, name:'Lightning Storm!'} : e.turn % 3 === 1 ? {block:10, strength:1, atk:'normal', dmg:6, name:'Gather Storm (1/2)'} : {atk:'pierce', dmg:8, brittle:1, blockAllies:4, name:'Static Charge (2/2)'}

colossalworm.name: Colossal Sandworm
colossalworm.desc: Burrows into the sand (Intangible), then erupts beneath the heroes.

ai.__fn: e => [{burrow:1, block:10, name:'Burrow'}, {atk:'aoe', dmg:9, name:'Erupt'}, {atk:'front', dmg:17, leech:1, name:'Devour'}][(e.turn - 1) % 3]

scarabqueen.name: Scarab Queen
scarabqueen.desc: Lays scarab eggs, sprays acid and hardens her shell.

ai.__fn:
e => { if(e.turn % 3 === 1 && alive().length < 5) return {summon:'scarab', block:10, name:'Hatch Brood'};
      return e.turn % 3 === 2 ? {atk:'splash', dmg:9, poison:2, name:'Acid Spray'} : {block:14, rallyStr:1, atk:'normal', dmg:8, name:'Royal Mandible'}; }

cactuswarlord.name: Cactus Warlord
cactuswarlord.desc: Thorns 3. Whirls his scimitars through your lines.

ai.__fn: e => [{atk:'aoe', dmg:6, name:'Whirling Scimitars'}, {atk:'pierce', dmg:12, name:'Spine Lance'}, {atk:'front', dmg:7, hits:2, name:'Desert Fury'}][(e.turn - 1) % 3]

miragedjinn.name: Mirage Djinn
miragedjinn.desc: Phases in and out (Intangible every other round) and strikes from behind.

ai.__fn: e => [{atk:'aoe', dmg:7, name:'Sand Blast'}, {atk:'back', dmg:13, name:'Mirage Strike'}, {weak:1, brittle:1, block:8, name:'Sandstorm Curse'}][(e.turn - 1) % 3]

snapjaw.name: Venus Snapjaw
snapjaw.desc: Regrows 3 turns after it dies – unless all its allies are dead.

thornstalker.name: Thorn Stalker
thornstalker.desc: Creeps through the undergrowth and stabs your back line with poisoned thorns.

shade.name: Phantom Shade
shade.desc: Phases in and out – every other round it is Intangible (takes at most 1 damage per hit).

cryptstalker.name: Crypt Stalker
cryptstalker.desc: A skeletal cutthroat. Slips into the shadows and stabs from behind.

crystalgolem.name: Crystal Golem
crystalgolem.desc: Armored (every hit deals 3 less damage) – and it keeps hardening.

cutthroat.name: Dwarf Cutthroat
cutthroat.desc: A tunnel raider. Throws a smoke bomb, then axes your back line.

burrower.name: Dune Burrower
burrower.desc: Burrows into the sand (Intangible), then bursts out behind your lines.

ai.__fn: e => { const u = 2 * biomeTier(); return [{burrow:1, block:6 + u, name:'Burrow'}, {atk:'back', dmg:13 + u, name:'Ambush'}, {atk:'back', dmg:5 + u / 2, hits:2, poison:1, name:'Sand Fangs'}][(e.turn - 1) % 3]; }

dunestalker.name: Dune Stalker
dunestalker.desc: Hides in the shimmering heat and stings your back line.

poachbrute.name: Poacher Brute
poachbrute.desc: A poacher with a stolen shield and a heavy club.

poacharcher.name: Poacher Marksman
poacharcher.desc: Shoots anything that moves – stags, spirits or heroes.

poachknife.name: Poacher Cutthroat
poachknife.desc: Skins prey for a living. Prefers it still breathing.

poachhex.name: Poacher Hedge-Witch
poachhex.desc: Brews curses from what the others leave behind.

BOSSES.name: Morrgan the Shapeshifter
BOSSES.desc: The druid of the raging woods starts as a Wolf. After a number of cards played by your team (more heroes: more cards) he interrupts: your turn ends, he does his shown action and then transforms – Bear (Block + heals 15%), Hawk (gains Strength) or Serpent (Poison on all heroes). Each transform is stronger than the last!

CLASS_INFO.knight: Heavy armor and big weapons. Tough, protects the team and hits hard.
CLASS_INFO.assassin: Quick and sneaky: cheap cards, lots of card draw, poison and deadly critical hits.
CLASS_INFO.mage: Master of fire, ice and lightning who burns, freezes and shocks enemies from the back row.
CLASS_INFO.ranger: Ranged fighter who marks enemies and chains clever combos into big finishing shots.
CLASS_INFO.brawler: Fist fighter who draws the enemies onto himself, soaks up their hits and hits back hard.
CLASS_INFO.soulbinder: Support who links, strengthens and creates cards for the whole team.
CLASS_INFO.eldritch: Wields the dark powers of the deep: slow and risky at first, terrifyingly strong later.

riches.name: Riches
riches.price: −10% max HP for every hero (permanent, at least 3).

power.name: Power

fx.__fn: () => 'Every hero upgrades 2 cards of their choice.'

power.price: Every hero gets 1 Hex in their deck.
power.price2: Every hero gets 2 Hex in their deck.

fx.__fn: () => 'Every hero makes 1 card of their choice Foil.'

life.name: Life

fx.__fn: () => 'All heroes heal fully and gain +8 max HP.'

life.price: Every hero loses 60 gold (or all they have).
life.price2: Every hero loses 120 gold (or all they have).

fortune.name: Fortune
fortune.price: Every hero starts the next 2 fights with Burn 5.
fortune.price2: Every hero starts the next 2 fights with Burn 10.

swiftness.name: Swiftness

fx.__fn: () => 'For the rest of the biome: +1 Energy in round 1.'

swiftness.price: Every hero starts every fight with Vulnerable 2.
swiftness.price2: Every hero starts every fight with Vulnerable 4.

protection.name: Protection
protection.price: Every hero loses 25% of their current HP now.
protection.price2: Every hero loses 2× 25% of their current HP now.

fx.__fn: () => 'Undo an earlier wish – its price and its gift.'

more.name: Wish for More Wishes
more.price: All prices double – also for wishes already granted.

def.name: Absorb
def.text: Damage that hits Block is stolen as your own Block.

def.name: Pass the Hangover
def.text: Every hit passes 1 stack of your own debuffs to the target.

off.name: Plunder
off.text: Steals one buff per target and gives it to you: Taunt → your Taunt, Strength → your Power (max 3), Bulwark → your Guard, Intangible → you become Invisible.

off.name: Focus
off.text: If all hits land on the same enemy, every hit Crits.

deepmark.name: Mark of the Deep
deepmark.buffText: Whenever you gain Corruption, gain 1 Block.

abyssalbinding.name: Abyssal Binding
abyssalbinding.buffText: Whenever your Sanity hits 0, gain 5 Block.

eldritchrestraint.name: Eldritch Restraint
eldritchrestraint.buffText: Whenever your Sanity hits 0, gain 3 Power.

harbinger.name: Harbinger of Ruin
tiers: returns to your hand if it kills

regaincontrol.name: Regain Control
regaincontrol.buffText: At the start of your turn: gain 5 Sanity and lose as much Corruption.

forbiddenone.name: The Forbidden One
forbiddenone.buffText: All your cards gain Vanish and deal +0.5% damage per Corruption.

embracevoid.name: Embrace the Void
embracevoid.buffText: Whenever you lose Sanity, deal 3 damage to ALL enemies.

dreameater.name: Dream Eater
dreameater.buffText: Dream stacks up to 20 (Nightmare at 20). Nightmares deal double damage. Reality Distortion steps become 6+, 12+ and 18+.
dreameater.buffTextUp: Dream stacks up to 20 (Nightmare at 20). Nightmares deal double damage and draw you 1 card. Reality Distortion steps become 6+, 12+ and 18+.

sleepingeyes.name: A Thousand Sleeping Eyes
sleepingeyes.buffText: Your attacks give enemies with Dream 1 more Dream. Every Nightmare draws you 1 card.
sleepingeyes.buffTextUp: Your attacks give enemies with Dream 1 more Dream. Every Nightmare draws you 1 card and gives 1 Energy.

hourawakening.name: The Hour of Awakening
hourawakening.buffText: from next round on, at the start of each of your turns, deal 18 damage to ALL enemies (each hit triggers Lingering Dreams).

ELITES.name: Swamp Hydra
ELITES.desc: Three body parts. Destroyed parts regrow after 3 turns – destroy all of them!

ai.__fn: e => e.turn % 2 ? {dmg:7, name:'Bite'} : {dmg:4, hits:2, name:'Snap'}
e => e.turn % 2 ? {block:10, name:'Harden Scales'} : {dmg:9, name:'Tail Lash'}
e => e.turn % 2 ? {dmg:4, poison:2, name:'Venom Spit'} : {dmg:7, name:'Bite'}

ELITES.name: Rust Wraith
ELITES.desc: Steals 1 Block strength from you every turn (Brittle).

ai.__fn: e => e.turn % 3 === 2 ? {dmg:4, hits:2, brittle:1, name:'Corrode'} : {dmg:7, brittle:1, name:'Rust Grasp'}

ELITES.name: Goblin Warchief
ELITES.desc: Summons a Goblin Grunt every turn. Grunts flee when he falls.

ai.__fn: e => alive().length < 5 ? {summon:'grunt', dmg:5, name:'Call to Arms'} : {dmg:11, name:'Cleaving Axe'}

ELITES.name: Iron Colossus
ELITES.desc: Gains 3 Strength after every attack. End this fast!

ai.__fn: e => ({dmg:6, strength:3, name:'Crushing Fist'})

ELITES.name: Plague Witch
ELITES.desc: Poisons you. Poison ignores your Block.

ai.__fn: e => e.turn % 2 ? {dmg:6, poison:3, name:'Toxic Bolt'} : {poison:5, block:8, name:'Miasma'}

ELITES.name: Bramble Golem
ELITES.desc: Thorns 3: you take damage every time you hit it. Careful with multi-hits!

ai.__fn: e => e.turn % 2 ? {dmg:10, name:'Thorn Slam'} : {block:12, dmg:5, name:'Bark Shield'}

ELITES.name: Vampire Lord
ELITES.desc: Heals for all unblocked damage. Keep your Block up!

ai.__fn: e => e.turn % 3 === 0 ? {dmg:4, hits:3, name:'Blood Feast'} : {dmg:9, name:'Drain Bite'}

ELITES.name: Lich King
ELITES.desc: Curses your deck with Hex cards that hurt you if they stay in your hand.

ai.__fn: e => e.turn % 3 === 1 ? {hex:2, block:8, name:'Curse'} : {dmg:11, name:'Soul Bolt'}

ELITES.name: Iron Juggernaut
ELITES.desc: Armored 4: every hit deals 4 less damage. Multi-hits barely scratch it – use heavy hits, Poison, Burn or Detonations.

ai.__fn: e => e.turn % 3 === 0 ? {dmg:18, name:'Steamroll'} : e.turn % 3 === 1 ? {block:14, dmg:6, name:'Grind'} : {dmg:9, brittle:1, name:'Piston Punch'}

ELITES.name: Blood Berserker
ELITES.desc: Rage: gains 1 Strength every time it is hit. Few big hits beat many small ones.

ai.__fn: e => e.turn % 2 ? {dmg:5, hits:2, name:'Twin Axes'} : {dmg:11, name:'Reckless Chop'}

ELITES.name: Necromancer

spring.name: The Heartwood Spring
story: Beneath the oldest tree in the woods, a spring glows a soft, living green. The water hums, and the roots around it twitch like sleeping fingers.
The roots whisper to each of you in turn. One gift each – no more.
spring.rules: Every hero takes one blessing. The spring falls silent once everyone has chosen.

opts.__fn:
() => [
      {id:'well', icon:'well', name:'Wellspring', fx:'Heal to full HP and remove all debuffs.', extra:h => h.spec === 'acolyte' ? 'Acolyte: also −15 Corruption.' : ''},
      {id:'heart', icon:'heartwood', name:'Heartwood', fx:`+${evL([6, 8, 10, 12])} max HP (and heal the same amount).`},
      {id:'prune', icon:'prune', name:'Pruning', fx:'Remove one card from your deck for free. Its gems return to your bag.', off:h => h.deck.length <= MIN_DECK ? `Deck needs more than ${MIN_DECK} cards` : ''}]

altar.name: The Bloodroot Altar
story: Black roots coil around a stone altar, clutching gems the way a miser clutches coins. The air smells of iron and wet earth.
The altar does not want gold. It wants blood – and the more you give, the brighter the stone it lets go.
altar.rules: Every hero may offer blood once – a share of their max HP. Current HP must be higher than the offer.

opts.__fn:
() => [
      {id:'thin', icon:'cut1', name:'Thin Cut', pct:15, tier:2, fx:'Lose 15% max HP: an Uncommon gem.'},
      {id:'deep', icon:'cut2', name:'Deep Cut', pct:30, tier:3, fx:'Lose 30% max HP: a Rare gem.'},
      {id:'vein', icon:'cut3', name:'Open Vein', pct:50, tier:4, fx:'Lose 50% max HP: an Epic gem.'},
      ...(evLevel() >= 3 ? [{id:'heart', icon:'cut4', name:"Heart's Blood", pct:75, tier:5, fx:'Lose 75% max HP: a Legendary gem.'}] : []),
      {id:'none', name:'Walk away', fx:'Offer nothing.', btn:true}].map(o => o.pct ? {...o, off:h => h.hp <= Math.round(h.maxHp * o.pct / 100) ? 'Not enough HP' : ''} : o)

hunt.name: The Spirit Hunt
story: Four trails cross the clearing: wolf, bear, serpent and falcon, each glowing faintly in the moss. Morrgan's forms walk these woods without him.
Hunt one down, and its spirit leaves a totem behind – a piece of power Morrgan will miss.
hunt.rules: Hunt one spirit together. Victory grants a totem that weakens that form of Morrgan in the boss fight. After a hunt you may chase a second, different spirit – there is no healing in between. Never more than two hunts.

stag.name: The Snared Stag
story: A white stag stands in the clearing, one leg caught in a poacher's snare. It does not struggle; it just watches you.
At the edge of the trees a campfire crackles. Voices drift over – poachers, arguing over what a white hide is worth.
stag.rules: The group votes. Every option affects the whole team.

bargain.name: The Dark Bargain
story: Under a starless sky, a tall figure waits beside a throne of black stone. Its smile is too wide, and its crown floats a hand's width above its head.
"Every crown has a price," it purrs. "Take a little curse – and wear a little crown."
bargain.rules: Every hero chooses a pact or declines. If anyone declines, the demon attacks.

opts.__fn:
() => [
      {id:'t1', icon:'pact1', name:'Lesser Pact', hex:1, fx:'1 Hex into your deck: choose 1 of 3 Epic cards.'},
      {id:'t2', icon:'pact2', name:'Greater Pact', hex:3, fx:'3 Hex into your deck: choose 1 of 3 Legendary cards.'},
      {id:'t3', icon:'pact3', name:'Crowned Pact', hex:5, fx:'5 Hex into your deck: choose 1 of 3 Legendary Foil cards.'},
      {id:'no', name:'Decline (anger the demon)', fx:'Anger the demon – an elite fight.', btn:true}]

mine.name: The Collapsing Mine
story: An abandoned mine shaft, older than the dwarves who last worked it. A cart still stands on the rails, waiting for someone to push.
The timbers groan as you step inside. Deeper down the walls glitter – and deeper down, the dust keeps falling.
mine.rules: Dig level by level, the cart collects everything you find. After every level the group votes: dig on or take the cart. A collapse loses the cart and hurts everyone (never deadly).

guild.name: The Guildhall Donation Drive
story: A great hall of the mountain folk, half rebuilt. A dwarf sits behind a ledger the size of a door, quill already wet.
"The Hall rebuilds," he says without looking up. "Every coin is written down – and the Hall remembers its friends."
guild.rules: Pay gold into the shared pot as often as you like. Every tier you reach helps ALL heroes when you leave.

golem.name: The Crystal Golem
story: A crystal giant sits half-buried in the snow, its eyes dim. It hums a single low note that makes your teeth ache.
Its chest is hollow, and something inside it is very, very hungry for gems.
golem.rules: Feed it a gem and it fights at your side for 3 fights – or smash it for its crystals.

avalanche.name: The Avalanche
story: Where the pass used to be, there is now a wall of snow and broken stone. Somewhere above you, something is still sliding.
You can dig, you can wait, or you can turn around and take the long road down the mountain.
avalanche.rules: Every option costs something. On a tie, you wait it out.

armory.name: The Abandoned Armory
story: A dwarven armory, its great door hanging open. Whoever could have locked it is long gone.
Treasures lie scattered across the floor, gleaming in the torchlight – but not enough for everyone to take what they want.
armory.rules: Every hero takes exactly one treasure – first come, first served. Team treasures help everyone. Whatever is left behind is lost.

oasis.name: The Oasis at Dusk
story: Palms, still water and a sinking sun. After days of sand, the oasis feels almost unreal.
For a few hours, nothing here wants to kill you. How you spend them is up to you.
oasis.rules: You have 3 hours. Every hour the group votes on one activity (repeats allowed).

storyNow.__fn:
ev => `

${ev.hour <= 3 ? `Hour ${ev.hour} of 3.` : 'The sun is gone. Stay for one more hour – or move on.'}${ev.log.length ? ' So far: ' + ev.log.join(', ') + '.' : ''}

`

djinn.name: The Djinn's Three Wishes
story: An old brass lamp lies half-buried in the dunes. The moment you touch it, violet smoke pours out and takes the shape of a grinning djinn.
"Three wishes," it booms. "No more, no less – and every wish has its price."
djinn.rules: Up to 3 wishes, one vote per wish. Every wish has a visible price.

storyNow.__fn:
ev => `

${ev.stage === 'free' ? 'Freedom: which wish do you take back?' : `Wish ${ev.count + 1} of ${ev.max}.`}${ev.made.length ? ' Granted: ' + ev.made.map(m => DJINN[m.w].name).join(', ') + '.' : ''}${ev.double ? ' All prices are doubled.' : ''}

`

caravan.name: The Stranded Caravan
story: Overturned wagons, scattered crates and a screaming merchant. Scarabs the size of dogs circle the wreck.
"Help us to the next well," the merchant begs, "and you'll have the best prices in the desert!"
caravan.rules: Help them, rob them – or walk past.

quicksand.name: The Quicksand
story: The sand gives way without a sound. By the time anyone screams, one of you is already sinking to the waist.
Every struggle pulls them deeper. Only the others can get them out – but it will cost them.
quicksand.rules: Without help the sinking hero loses 40% of their current HP and a random card is buried. Every other hero can help once – if everyone helps, they are saved.

who.__fn: ev => { const o = heroList().filter(h => !h.dead && h.id !== ev.sinker); return o.length ? o : heroList().filter(h => h.id === ev.sinker); }

ev => heroList().filter(h => !h.dead && h.id !== ev.sinker).length ? [
      {id:'rope', icon:'rope', name:'Rope', fx:'Pay 30 gold.', off:h => h.gold < 30 ? 'Not enough gold' : ''},
      {id:'pull', icon:'pull', name:'Pull', fx:'Lose 15% of your max HP.', off:h => h.hp <= Math.round(h.maxHp * .15) ? 'Not enough HP' : ''},
      {id:'sacrifice', icon:'sacrifice', name:'Sacrifice', fx:'A random card from your deck is lost (its gems return to your bag).', off:h => h.deck.length <= MIN_DECK ? `Deck needs more than ${MIN_DECK} cards` : ''},
      {id:'none', name:"Don't help", fx:'', btn:true}]
      : [{id:'none', name:'Struggle alone', fx:'', btn:true}]

manor.name: The Hollow Manor
story: A villa stands alone in the moonlight, bats circling its gables. A single window burns with candlelight.
Inside, the halls are silent. Two doors on every floor – and behind each one, something is waiting.
manor.rules: On each of the first two floors, pick one of two doors. Every sign fits two possible rooms. You may leave after every floor and keep what you found. The attic holds the master of the house.

storyNow.__fn:
ev => `

${ev.last ? `${ev.last} ` : ''}${ev.floor <= 2 ? `Floor ${ev.floor}: two doors.` : 'Only the attic remains.'}

`

ferry.name: The Ferryman's Toll
story: A black river creeps through the mist. A narrow boat drifts out of it, lit by a single pale lantern.
The hooded ferryman holds out a bony hand. "A coin for the crossing," he rasps. "Pay now – and I will refuse you later."
ferry.rules: A coin protects one hero until (and including) the biome boss: if they fall, they rise again at once – once. Anyone can pay for anyone. Unused coins are lost at the end of the biome.

embrace.name: The Crimson Embrace
story: On a gothic balcony beneath a blood-red moon, a pale herald of the Vampire Lord raises a golden chalice.
"One of you," she smiles, "may drink. A taste – or the full embrace."
embrace.rules: One hero may volunteer. Only one hero per run can accept the Embrace.

forge.name: The Forge
forge.desc: The blacksmith is away. His hammer and anvil are free to use – upgrade cards (+25% to all their values, or 1 Energy cheaper for 5-Energy cards) as often as you dare. After the first upgrade there is a 20% chance he comes back, after every further one 20% more… and he will not be happy.
story: Beside the old mine road you find a forge that someone left in a hurry. The hearth still glows, the bellows hang half-drawn, and a heavy hammer rests on the anvil.
There is no sign of the blacksmith – only fresh footprints in the ash, leading out into the dark. Whatever he was working on, the iron is still warm.

arena.name: The Arena
arena.desc: A crowd roars. Fight for prizes: Easy is a normal fight, Medium an elite, Hard two elites at once.
story: Sand, sweat and thunder. A colosseum rises out of the wasteland, its stands full of a crowd you cannot quite see – but you can hear it.
A gate grinds open and the arena master offers you three fights. The harder the fight, the better the prize.

buddy.name: Build your Buddy
buddy.desc: A strange workbench. Roll a rarity (at least Uncommon), then build your own card: for every rarity step it gets one modification (choose 1 of 2) and one gem slot. Modifications stack.
story: The road leads you to an abandoned factory. Rusty conveyor belts, silent presses, shelves full of spare parts – and in the middle of it all a workbench that still hums with a faint glow.
A half-finished little machine stares up at you with one lit eye. Next to it, a crooked sign: BUILD YOUR OWN BUDDY.
buddy.rules: Roll a rarity (at least Uncommon), then build your own card: for every rarity step it gets one modification (choose 1 of 2) and one gem slot. Modifications stack.

anomaly.name: The Anomaly
anomaly.desc: A shimmering rift. Throw a card in and it comes back as a different, random card. The first try is free, every further try costs 10 Gold more. Every player transforms cards in their own deck and pays for their own tries – the price rises for each hero separately.
story: The air tastes of metal. Ahead of you the world has torn open: a rift as tall as a tower, humming with violet light, pulling at your cards and your thoughts. Shapes turn inside it that are not quite shapes.
You could step inside and see what happens.
anomaly.rules: Throw a card in and it comes back as a different, random card. The first try is free, every further try costs 10 Gold more. Every player transforms cards in their own deck and pays for their own tries.

GLOSS_STATUS: If this card is not played, it stays in your hand for the next turn.
Your next 3 attacks deal extra damage per hit.
Your next attack deals extra damage per hit.
Your next Back Attack deals 100% more damage (upgraded 150%).
This turn, every kill creates a random Gem (normal Gem drop chances) directly in your inventory.
Marks an enemy: the Executioner's next attacks against it deal extra damage, more if they Assassinate.
Marks the last enemy: the Executioner's Back Attacks deal extra damage to it this turn.
The next Poison tick on this enemy deals more damage.
Until the end of the fight: Greed grants +1 damage per hit for every 25 Gold instead (max +20 at 500 Gold).
Until the end of the fight: gain 2 Gold per card played, +1 damage per hit for every 50 Gold, and +2 more at 200 Gold (upgraded 3 / +3).
Until the end of the fight: whenever Poison is applied to you, +2 damage per hit. At 10 self-inflicted Poison your attacks deal double damage (upgraded +3 / 8).
Extra damage per hit from Self-Inflicted Mutation.
Your attacks deal double damage for the rest of the fight.
Until the end of the fight: at the end of each round in which you are Poisoned, heal 2 HP (upgraded 3).
Until the end of the fight: your Back Attacks deal 8 more damage (upgraded 11).
Until the end of the fight: from the next round on, at the start of your turn, ALL enemies take 18 damage (upgraded 24).
Until the end of the fight: at the end of your turn, each Poisoned enemy gains 3 Poison, +2 more if you are Poisoned (upgraded 5 / +4).
Until the end of the fight: whenever you apply Poison to an enemy, apply 1 Poison to yourself. At 10 self-inflicted Poison: use it up, gain 2 Energy and draw 2 (upgraded 8 / 3 / 3).
Until the end of the fight: whenever the Acolyte gains Corruption, he gains Block.
Until the end of the fight: whenever his Sanity hits 0, he gains Block.
Until the end of the fight: whenever his Sanity hits 0, he gains Power.
Until the end of the fight: at the start of his turn he gains Sanity and loses Corruption (never below 0).
Until the end of the fight: all his cards have Vanish and deal +0.5% damage per Corruption (+50% at 100).
Until the end of the fight: Dream on enemies stacks up to 20 (Nightmare at 20) and Nightmares deal double damage (40% of max HP, bosses 20%). Upgraded: draw 1 card whenever a Nightmare triggers.
Until the end of the fight: your attacks give enemies with Dream 1 more Dream, and every Nightmare draws you 1 card (upgraded: +1 Energy too).
Until the end of the fight: whenever he loses Sanity, ALL enemies take damage.
Permanent for the whole run (max 100). At 10 / 25 / 50 / 100 the Acolyte's cards get bonuses and his body changes. Costs Sanity every turn.
Loses its next turn. For the Acolyte it happens when his Sanity hits 0 – then Sanity refills.

Extra damage, depending on the target's Dream before the hit. 3+ Dream: +6 damage. 6+ Dream: +9 damage. 9+ Dream: +12 damage and it triggers a Nightmare that deals 50% more damage. With Dream Eater the steps are 6+, 12+ and 18+ (the Nightmare then deals double damage +50%).

4+: deals 25% less damage · 7+: takes 25% more damage · 10 (20 with Dream Eater): Nightmare – Dream consumed, loses 20% of its max HP (bosses 10%), ignoring Block. Reality Distortion triggers it already at 9.
Resource for summoning Servants of the Deep. Builds up during the fight.

Summoned creatures of the Deep (max 5). They act on their own and stay until the fight ends. Summoning a 6th lets you send one back. Attack boni only affect Servants that attack (not the Healer or Guardian).
The Servant is removed for good – in exchange the card gives you its effect.

The Servant is sacrificed and thrown: it deals its attack × the card's multiplier as damage to the target (a random enemy if the target is dead). An Abyssal Healer heals ALL heroes for that much instead, an Abyssal Guardian gives ALL heroes its Block × the multiplier instead.
Until the end of the fight: every Servant you summon gains extra attack.
Until the end of the fight: every Servant you summon gains extra attack.
Until the end of the fight: whenever a Servant attacks, it gains attack. Servants with 20+ attack attack twice at the end of your turn.
Until the end of the fight: whenever a Drowned Spawn attacks, it also deals 50% of its attack to ALL enemies.
The first time you have 20 Depth: all Depth is spent and The Sleeping One appears for free. Waits while you have 5 Servants. Once per fight.

Links two cards, ideally of different heroes (same color + chain number on both). Playing one makes the other Resonate. Playing a Resonating card: ALL its values +50% (damage, Block, cards drawn, Energy, buffs, debuffs) and the other card's owner draws 1. Links last the whole fight.
A colored mark on a card: Edge (+damage), Ward (+Block), Haste (−cost), Mend (heal) or Echo (plays twice). Same kinds stack. Lasts until the end of the fight (★ = permanent).

Created cards cost 0 and vanish after use. Tailored Gifts fit the specialization that gets them – every spec has its own Gift with its own mechanics. All forged cards are listed under Unique Cards in the Soulforger glossary.
Absorbs incoming attack damage. Heroes lose their Block at the start of each round, enemies at the start of their turn.
Buff cards are played once per fight and last until it ends. Might: attacks deal extra damage per hit.
A card that was already played this turn and is drawn again costs +1 Energy per earlier play – only for this turn. Stops endless loops with tiny decks.
You can hold at most 10 cards. Draws beyond that do nothing.
A card with Vanish goes to the Vanished pile when played and comes back next fight. All Buff cards have Vanish.
Gain Block at the start of each of your turns until the end of the fight.
Double damage. A Crit needs a trigger, which is named on the card or in the class passive.

Choose 1 of 3 cards at 50% off – or none. At least one is Rare (upgraded: at least one Epic). The card goes into your deck for good and into your hand right away. Foil: one offer is Foil and costs double.
Deals 50% more damage to the last (right-most) enemy. Enemies in front of it are hit normally.
Always hits the enemy in front – no target needed.
Always hits the enemy at the back – no target needed.
Hits the target and the enemies right next to it (the card says how many).
Hits the target, and the enemy behind it for half damage.
Playing this card adds the named card to your hand. That card has Vanish and is gone after the fight – it never stays in your deck.
This card always starts the fight in your starting hand.
When played, this card is removed from your deck permanently.
This card never starts in your starting hand – it begins the fight in your draw pile.
Detonate X: all Marks on the enemy explode – X damage per Mark, plus +1% per Mark (like every hit). The Marks are used up.

A Marked enemy takes +1% damage per Mark from every hit – from every hero (40 Marks = +40%). Marks stay until a Detonate effect makes them explode (damage per Mark, also boosted by the +%). When a Marked enemy dies, its Marks are gone.

Max 10, lasts the whole fight. +1 whenever the Ranger plays a card of a different type than his previous one (Attack → Skill → Block …), more from cards. Finishers and “Spend Momentum” effects use it.
Every card of the Rift Architect has a Rune slot. Runes are made with the card Rune Forge and socketed like gems; they change how the card works.
Whenever you gain Momentum, gain 1 more until the end of the fight.

A buff that only works in the front slot. Until the taunter's next turn, single-target enemy attacks hit only the taunting hero; area and splash attacks stay as they are. An enemy that would not attack this round attacks the taunter anyway, in addition to its action, with its weakest attack (or a weak basic hit). If the taunter is moved out of the front slot, the Taunt breaks. Enemies taunt the same way: only the front enemy can taunt – your single-target attacks must then hit it.
Each stack: 10% less damage taken (max. 50%). Every hit taken removes 1 stack.
+4 damage per stack on the next hit, then it is used up.
+1 per enemy hit taken. At 5 the Knockout Punch hits the enemy with the most HP (start of turn, or right away through Fury cards).
Stacks from his hits. An ally attack cashes in the whole stack: +1 damage per stack, all heroes get 50% as Block, the Street Fighter gets Payback.
Until the end of the fight: gain Guard at the start of each of your turns (Safety Net, Come At Me).
Until the end of the fight: gain 3 Gold for every Deserves a Beating stack that is cashed in (max 30 Gold per fight, upgraded 45).
Until the end of the fight: gain 1 Energy at the start of each of your turns, and every enemy gets 5 Deserves a Beating each turn.
+1 damage per stack on all his hits in his next turn. Finishers spend it for extra damage.
Payback that becomes active at the start of the next round.
Every hit of your attacks also applies Poison until the end of the fight.
Crit attacks always Crit against every enemy, also those in front, until the end of the fight.
Lightning damage ranges always roll their maximum until the end of the fight.
Draw extra cards at the start of each of your turns until the end of the fight.

Single-target enemy attacks deal no damage until the hero's next turn. Splash, Piercing and Area Attacks still hit fully. If all teammates are dead, the enemies find you and single-target attacks deal 50% damage. The next attack card deals 50% more damage and uses Invisible up.
Deals 33% less attack damage. Wears off by 1 each turn.
Takes 33% more damage from every source – attacks, Poison, Burn and more. Wears off by 1 each turn. Some enemies can make your heroes Vulnerable too.
Enemies lose HP equal to their Poison at the END of their turn, heroes at the END of the round. Poison ignores Block. Then it goes down by 1.
Enemies lose HP equal to their Burn at the START of their turn, heroes at the start of their turn. Ignores Block, then goes down by 1.
At 10 stacks (bosses: 20) the enemy is Frozen. An enemy can never be frozen two turns in a row.

When you play it, choose one: Plunder – steals one buff per target (Taunt, Strength → Power, Bulwark → Guard, Intangible → Invisible). Pierce – ignores Block. Focus – if all hits land on the same enemy, every hit Crits.
When you play it, choose one: Absorb – damage that hits Block becomes your own Block. Pass the Hangover – every hit passes 1 stack of your debuffs to the target. Second Wind – heal 1 per hit.
An enemy can lose a turn (Frozen, Corrupted Mind, stuns) only every other round. Right after losing a turn it is immune until it has acted again.
Block gained from cards is reduced by this amount. Lasts for the whole fight.
Attacks deal this much extra damage.
Enemies: you take damage every time you hit them. Heroes: attackers take damage for every hit, until the hero's next turn.
Every enemy hit on this hero gives the attacker Burn. Lasts until the hero's next turn.
Every enemy hit on this hero gives the attacker Ice. Lasts until the hero's next turn.
Every enemy hit on this hero deals random damage back to the attacker. Lasts until the hero's next turn.
For a few enemy turns, all enemies take damage and Ice at the start of the enemy turn.
Heals for all unblocked damage it deals.
A destroyed part grows back after 3 turns unless all parts are destroyed.
Calls minions. They flee when their master falls.
Adds Hex curses to your discard pile. Each Hex in hand at the end of a turn deals 3 damage.
The enemy will apply a negative effect to your heroes.
The enemy will make itself stronger.

Elemental Mage cards show their element (Fire, Ice or Lightning) in the top right corner. Playing all 3 elements in one turn makes the next elemental card this turn play twice (Elemental Instability, once per turn). Lightning damage is random, Fire builds Burn, Ice builds Ice until the enemy is Frozen.
Frost, Fire and Static Armor: Block, and the next enemy that hits the hero gets Ice, Burn or Lightning damage.

The Druid always walks with one Spirit: Wolf (+5 damage against Weak enemies), Bear (every hero ignores the first 3 damage from enemies each round), Deer (+4 heal on heroes below 50% HP), Raven (Skills: 33% to draw 1, once per round) or Spider (each attack hit applies 1 Poison). At the start of each round and when the Spirit changes (not to the same one) he gets its Spirit Card: free, Vanish – Wolf: 2 damage + Weak, Bear: Guard + 2 Block, Deer: heal 3, Raven: draw 1, Spider: 3 Poison.

After 3 healing effects in one turn (Fractured Halo can change this) the Celestial Mage enters Wrath for the rest of the turn: single-target heals hit an enemy, heals on all heroes hit ALL enemies, heal over time becomes damage over time. Cleanse and Block stay the same.
The next attack of this hero deals that much more damage, then Empower is used up.
Heals again at the start of later turns.
The hero takes a percentage less damage (Veil until your next turn, Wings for the whole fight). At most 75%.
The enemy takes more Fire damage – also from Burn.
Removes debuffs from a hero, the most recently applied first.

NORMALS.desc: Unpredictable: stabs, throws daggers or plays dirty tricks (Weak).

NORMALS.name: Skeleton
NORMALS.desc: Slashes, cracks your armor (Brittle) and reassembles stronger.

ai.__fn: e => [ {block:9, strength:1, name:'Reassemble'}, {dmg:7, name:'Rusty Slash'}, {dmg:4, brittle:1, name:'Bone Crack'} ][e.turn % 3]

NORMALS.desc: Opens with a War Cry, then alternates heavy smashes and double chops.

ai.__fn: e => e.turn === 1 ? {strength:2, block:5, name:'War Cry'} : e.turn % 2 === 0 ? {dmg:11, name:'Smash'} : {dmg:6, hits:2, name:'Double Chop'}

e => e.turn % 3 === 1 ? {dmg:2, weak:1, name:'Web Shot'} : {dmg:4, hits:2, name:'Double Bite'}

NORMALS.name: Gargoyle
NORMALS.desc: Turns to stone (huge Block), then dives down for massive damage.

ai.__fn: e => e.turn % 2 ? {block:22, name:'Stone Form'} : {dmg:17, name:'Dive'}

normal.name: Enemies
normal.desc: A regular fight. Card, gem and gold rewards.

elite.name: Elite
elite.desc: A dangerous elite – which one is unknown. Better gold.

camp.name: Campfire
camp.desc: Each hero either rests (heal 30%), upgrades a card or takes a gem out of a card.

shop.name: Shop
shop.desc: Buy cards and gems with your gold.

event.name: Event
event.desc: Something unusual… a choice, a chance or a trap.

boss.name: Boss
boss.desc: A boss you have not fought yet awaits.

marking.name: Rune of Marking
marking.fx: +10 Mark on every hit or target

ruin.name: Rune of Ruin
ruin.fx: Afterwards: Detonate the target's Marks (1 damage each)

echo.name: Rune of Echo
echo.fx: Adds a free copy to your hand (once)

siphon.name: Rune of Siphon
siphon.fx: If the target is Marked: gain 2 Energy

growth.name: Rune of Growth
growth.fx: Attacks: +2 damage permanently each time it is played

spawn.name: Drowned Spawn
spawn.text: At the end of your turn: hits a random enemy for {a}.

guardian.name: Abyssal Guardian
guardian.text: At the start of your turn: you gain {b} Block, all other heroes {o} Block.

leviathan.name: Leviathan
leviathan.text: At the end of your turn: hits ALL enemies for {a} and gives you 1 Depth.

sleeper.name: The Sleeping One
sleeper.text: At the end of your turn: hits ALL enemies for {a}.

assassin.name: Abyssal Assassin
assassin.text: At the end of your turn: Back Attack for {a}.

exploder.name: Abyssal Exploder
exploder.text: After 2 of your turns: explodes for {a} damage to ALL enemies, then it is gone.

healer.name: Abyssal Healer
healer.text: At the end of your turn: heals the hero with the lowest HP for {a}.

SHIFTER_BOSS.name: Morrgan the Shapeshifter
SHIFTER_BOSS.desc: The druid of the raging woods starts as a Wolf. After a number of cards played by your team (more heroes: more cards) he interrupts: your turn ends, he does his shown action and then transforms – Bear (Block + heals 15%), Hawk (gains Strength) or Serpent (Poison on all heroes). Each transform is stronger than the last!

ai.__fn: e => SHIFT_FORMS[e.form || 'wolf'].ai(e)
e => hasTotem('wolf') ? {...base.wolf(e), hits:2, name:'Flanking Pounce (weakened)'} : base.wolf(e)
e => hasTotem('bear') ? {...base.bear(e), block:7, name:'Maul (weakened)'} : base.bear(e)
e => { const it = base.serpent(e); if(!hasTotem('serpent')) return it; const o = {...it, poison:1, name:'Venom Fang (weakened)'}; delete o.weak; return o; }
e => { const it = base.hawk(e); if(!hasTotem('hawk')) return it; const o = {...it, dmg:5, name:'Diving Talons (weakened)'}; delete o.brittle; return o; }

SMITH.name: Furious Blacksmith
SMITH.desc: He caught you at his anvil. Heats up, hammers hard and sprays molten metal (Burn). His hot apron gives Thorns 2.

soulanvil.name: Soul Anvil
soulanvil.buffText: At the start of each turn, a random ally gets a Tailored Gift.

knight.name: Templar
knight.desc: Shields the whole team, heals and punishes attackers with Thorns. His attacks are weaker but also give Block.
knight.passive: Whenever the Templar plays a non-Attack card, he gains 1 Block and 2 Thorns until his next turn.

knight.name: Barbarian
knight.desc: Huge damage, Weak and Vulnerable. Some cards hurt him for even more damage – Meat Shanks heal him back up.
knight.passive: The first time each turn the Barbarian kills an enemy, he draws 1 card and gains 2 Energy.

knight.name: Gladiator
knight.desc: A balanced fighter with solid attacks and defenses who grows stronger with every fight.
knight.passive: After every won fight, one random card gains +1 damage and another gains +1 Block – permanently.

mage.name: Elemental Mage
mage.desc: A living source of raw energy. Fire burns, Ice freezes, Lightning strikes many times – mixing all three makes him unstable and dangerous.
mage.passive: If you play cards of all 3 elements (Fire, Ice, Lightning) in one turn, your next elemental card this turn is played twice. Once per turn.

mage.name: Druid
mage.desc: Part of an ancient forest. A random animal Spirit walks with him; he changes Spirits to heal, protect, draw or hunt.
mage.passive: Each fight starts with a random Spirit: Wolf (+5 damage against Weak enemies), Bear (every hero ignores the first 3 damage from enemies each round), Deer (+4 heal on heroes below 50% HP), Raven (Skills: 33% to draw 1, once per round) or Spider (each attack hit applies 1 Poison). At the start of each round and whenever you change your Spirit you get its free Spirit Card (Vanish).

mage.name: Celestial Mage
mage.desc: A being that carries too much light. He heals – until the fractured halo breaks and his healing turns into burning judgment.
mage.passive: When you trigger 3 healing effects in one turn, you enter Wrath for the rest of the turn: single-target heals deal damage to an enemy, heals on all heroes damage ALL enemies, heal over time becomes damage over time. Cleanse and Block stay the same.

assassin.name: Thief
assassin.desc: Slippery and rich: steals and spends Gold – the more Gold he owns, the harder he hits.
assassin.passive: The Thief deals +1 damage per hit for every 50 Gold he owns (max +10 at 500 Gold).

assassin.name: Executioner
assassin.desc: Lethal damage from the shadows: Backattacks on the last enemy, Invisible tricks and Combo Follow-ups.
assassin.passive: When the Executioner kills an enemy, he becomes Invisible.

assassin.name: Deathbringer
assassin.desc: Drowns enemies in Poison – and poisons himself for power. Poison keeps spreading.
assassin.passive: When a poisoned enemy dies, its Poison spreads to the nearest enemy. Poison on the Deathbringer deals only 50% damage.

ranger.name: Deadeye
ranger.desc: Single-target burst. Marks the target, then crits it hard. His Crits trigger only against enemies with 20 or more Marks.
ranger.passive:
The Deadeye's Crit attacks Crit only against enemies with 20 or more Marks – wherever they stand.
Momentum (all Rangers): +1 whenever you play a different card type than your previous card (Attack → Skill → Block …). Max 10, lasts the whole fight; finishers and “Spend Momentum” effects use it.

ranger.name: Stormweaver
ranger.desc: Multi-hits, procs and combo chains. Long turns create free Spark Arrows that keep the chain going.
ranger.passive:
Every 3rd card the Stormweaver plays in a turn adds a Spark Arrow to his hand (0 Energy, 4 damage, 1 Mark, once).
Momentum (all Rangers): +1 whenever you play a different card type than your previous card (Attack → Skill → Block …). Max 10, lasts the whole fight; finishers and “Spend Momentum” effects use it.

ranger.name: Rift Architect
ranger.desc: Builds custom attacks: every card has a Rune slot next to its gem slots. Runes change how a card works – Marks, Momentum, Echoes, Detonations …
ranger.passive:
All of the Rift Architect's cards have a Rune slot. Runes are made with Rune Forge (in his starting deck).
Momentum (all Rangers): +1 whenever you play a different card type than your previous card (Attack → Skill → Block …). Max 10, lasts the whole fight; finishers and “Spend Momentum” effects use it.

brawler.name: Knockout Champion
brawler.desc: No attack or Block cards: he buffs himself with Power, Combo, Reach and Guard, provokes the enemies – and every 5 hits he takes, he answers with one devastating Knockout Punch. Fragile: 60 Max HP, only 50% Block.
brawler.passive:
Starts with only 60 Max HP and gains only 50% of all Block. Heals 35% of the damage his Knockout Punch deals.
Knockout Punch: every enemy hit he takes gives 1 Fury. At 5 Fury he automatically punches the enemy with the most HP at the start of his turn (Fury cards can trigger it right away) – with enough Fury for two punches, he punches twice. Every hit deals +10% of his Max HP extra, and every punch gives him +1 Max HP. The punch uses the Knockout Punch card – socket gems into it!

brawler.name: Drunk Kung Fu Master
brawler.desc: No Block cards – her attacks are the defense. When playing an attack, she picks a bonus: defensive (Absorb Block, pass on debuffs, heal) or offensive (Plunder, Pierce, Focus).
brawler.passive: All her attacks hit random enemies.

brawler.name: Street Fighter at Night
brawler.desc: Many light multi-hits that mark enemies for his team, plus a few brutal finishers that cash in everything he has earned.
brawler.passive: Every hit puts Deserves a Beating on the target. When an ally attacks it, the whole stack is cashed in: +1 damage per stack, all heroes get 50% of it as Block – and he gets that many Payback stacks: +1 damage on every hit in his next turn. His finishers spend all Payback for big damage.

soulbinder.name: Chainweaver
soulbinder.desc: Soulbinds cards of different heroes. Playing a linked card makes its partner Resonate – all values of the Resonating card rise by 50% (damage, Block, cards, Energy, buffs, debuffs) and its partner's owner draws a card.
soulbinder.passive:
Whenever a Soulbind completes, ALL enemies take 3 damage for every active Soulbind.
Soulbind: play one linked card → its partner Resonates. Play the Resonating card → ALL its values +50% (also cards, Energy, buffs, debuffs) and the other owner draws 1. Links last the whole fight.

soulbinder.name: Runebinder
soulbinder.desc: Etches Imprints onto her allies' cards: Edge (+damage), Ward (+Block), Haste (−cost), Mending (heal) and Echo (plays twice). Imprints of the same kind stack.
soulbinder.passive:
After every won fight, one random attack card in the team's decks permanently gains +2 damage and one random skill or block card permanently gains +2 Block (★).
Imprint: a bonus on a card in a hero's hand. It lasts until the end of the fight.

soulbinder.name: Soulforger
soulbinder.desc: Forges cards for her allies: Soul Sparks, Spirit Wards and Tailored Gifts made for each specialization, using that hero's own mechanics.
soulbinder.passive:
Whenever any hero plays a card she created, she gains 1 Energy (max 3 per round).
Soulcraft: created cards cost 0 and vanish after use.

eldritch.name: Cthulhu's Acolyte
eldritch.desc: Corruption cards make him stronger forever – and turn him step by step into a monster. At 10 / 25 / 50 / 100 Corruption his cards gain bonuses; some Block cards turn into life-stealing attacks. But his Sanity drains faster the more corrupted he is.
eldritch.passive:
+1 damage per hit for every 20 Corruption. Whenever he transforms (0 → 10 → 25 → 50 → 100 Corruption, or back), he draws 1 card.
Corruption: permanent for the whole run (max 100). Sanity: each turn he loses 1 Sanity per 10 Corruption. At 0 he gets Corrupted Mind: he loses his turn and ALL his Energy, then Sanity refills. At 100 Corruption, every further Corruption he gains costs 1 Sanity.

eldritch.name: Cthulhu's Dreamweaver
eldritch.desc: Marks enemies with Dream and decides when to cash it in: early for small effects, or wait for a Nightmare. Some cards change with the target's Dream (Reality Distortion).
eldritch.passive:
Whenever ANY hero's attack hits an enemy that has Dream, it gains +1 Dream (once per card).
Dream: 4+ = deals 25% less damage · 7+ = takes 25% more damage · 10 = Nightmare: the Dream is consumed and it loses 20% of its max HP (bosses 10%), ignoring Block.

eldritch.name: Cthulhu's Tidecaller
eldritch.desc: Builds Depth and summons Servants of the Deep that fight for the team. Feed them, fuse them – or sacrifice them for Depth, cards and Block. Starts slow, grows every turn.
eldritch.passive:
Start every fight with 3 Depth. Gain 1 Depth at the start of each of your turns, and 1 Depth whenever an enemy dies.
Servants (max 5) act on their own and stay until the fight ends: Spawn (2 Depth) · Healer (3) · Guardian, Assassin, Exploder (4) · Leviathan (8) · The Sleeping One (10).

tip.__fn: () => `Taunt (buff): your single-target attacks must hit this enemy until its next turn. Only works while it is the front enemy. Can be plundered.`
n => `Bulwark: takes ${n}% less damage until its next turn.`
() => `Overgrown: +${AFX().overgrown}% damage and Block for this fight.`
n => `Witching Hour: +${AFX().witch * n} damage per hit for the rest of the fight.`
() => `Protector: regularly shields its allies with Block instead of attacking.`
() => `Tactician: every third turn it rallies its allies (+1 Strength).`
() => `Healer: heals its allies. Low HP – take it out first!`
() => `Buffer: makes its allies stronger. Low HP – take it out first!`

() => `Taunt: single-target enemy attacks hit only this hero until his next turn (area and splash attacks stay as they are). Enemies that would not attack hit him anyway with a weak attack. Only works in the front slot – moved back, the Taunt breaks.`
n => `Guard ${n}: takes ${Math.round(Math.min(GUARD_MAX, n * GUARD_PCT) * 10) * 10}% less damage. Each hit taken removes 1 stack.`
n => `Power ${n}: the next hit deals +${n * POWER_DMG} damage, then Power is used up.`
n => `Combo: the next Knockout Punch hits ${n} more time${n > 1 ? 's' : ''}.`
n => `Reach: the next Knockout Punch hits ${n} more enem${n > 1 ? 'ies' : 'y'}.`
n => `Fury ${n}/${FURY_NEED}: every enemy hit taken gives 1 Fury. At ${FURY_NEED} the Knockout Punch fires.`
n => `Deserves a Beating ${n}: the next ally attack cashes it in – +${n} damage, every hero gets ${Math.floor(n / 2)} Block and the Street Fighter gets ${n} Payback.`
n => `Payback ${n}: +${n} damage on every hit this turn. Finishers spend it for more damage.`
n => `Payback ${n} (next turn): becomes active at the start of the next round.`
n => `Guard every turn (buff): gain ${n} Guard at the start of each turn.`
(n, u) => `Stock Market Genius (buff): 3 Gold for every Deserves a Beating stack that is cashed in (max ${n} Gold per fight). Earned this fight: ${(u && u.stockGot) || 0} Gold.`
() => `Pyramid Scheme (buff): +1 Energy at the start of each turn, and every enemy gets 5 Deserves a Beating each turn.`
n => `Training Montage (buff): Knockout Punch deals +${n} damage.`
n => `Armored ${n}: every hit against it deals ${n} less damage. Poison, Burn and Detonations ignore armor.`
() => `Rage: gains 1 Strength every time it is hit.`
() => `Split: turns into two Slimelings when it dies.`
() => `Phasing: becomes Intangible every other turn.`
() => `Intangible: all damage against it is reduced to 1 – hits, Poison, Burn and Nightmares.`
n => `Drained: gets ${n} less Energy at the start of the next round.`
n => `Aegis: a ${n}-point shield that absorbs damage before Block and HP. Break it before the Annihilation Beam fires!`
() => `Twin Bond: when the other twin dies, this one gains 5 Strength and heals.`

() => `Restless: after ${shiftLimit()} cards played by your team it interrupts – your turn ends, it does its shown action and then transforms. Bear: Block + heals 15%. Hawk: Strength for the fight. Serpent: Poison on all heroes. Every transform is stronger than the last.`
n => `Mark: this enemy takes +${n}% damage from every hit (from every hero). Marks stay until a Detonate effect makes them explode – the explosion also gets the +${n}%.`
n => `Momentum: ${n} (max 10). Gained by playing a different card type than your previous card, and by cards. Finishers spend it.`
n => `Master Plan (buff): whenever you gain Momentum, gain ${n} more until the end of the fight.`
n => `Vulnerable: takes ${Math.round(VULN_MULT*100 - 100)}% more damage from every source, also Poison and Burn. ${n} turn${n>1?'s':''} left.`
n => `Might (buff): this hero's attacks deal +${n} damage per hit until the end of the fight.`
n => `Iron Will (buff): gain ${n} Block at the start of each of this hero's turns until the end of the fight.`
() => `Killer Instinct (buff): Crit attacks always Crit against every enemy until the end of the fight.`
() => `Overload (buff): lightning damage ranges always roll their maximum until the end of the fight.`
n => `Archmage's Insight (buff): draw ${n} extra card${n>1?'s':''} at the start of each turn until the end of the fight.`
n => `Venomous Edge (buff): every hit of this hero's attacks applies ${n} Poison until the end of the fight.`

() => `Invisible: single-target enemy attacks deal no damage until this hero's next turn (Splash, Piercing and Area Attacks still hit fully) – if all teammates are dead, the enemies find you and you take 50% damage. The next attack card deals 50% more damage – that uses up Invisible.`
n => `Weak: deals ${Math.round(100 - WEAK_MULT*100)}% less attack damage. ${n} turn${n>1?'s':''} left.`

(n,u) => u.hero ? `Poison: you lose ${n} HP at the END of the round (after the enemies), ignoring Block. Then it is reduced by 1.` : `Poison: loses ${n} HP at the END of its turn (ignores Block), then Poison is reduced by 1.`

(n,u) => u.hero ? `Burn: you lose ${n} HP at the start of your turn (ignores Block), then it is reduced by 1.` : `Burn: loses ${n} HP at the START of its turn (ignores Block), then Burn is reduced by 1.`
(n,u) => `Ice: at ${u.boss ? ICE_BOSS : ICE_NORMAL} stacks it is Frozen and skips its next turn. Can't be frozen two turns in a row.`
() => `Frozen: skips its next turn.`
() => `CC Immunity: just lost a turn – can't be frozen or stunned again until it has acted.`
n => `Brittle: Block gained from cards is reduced by ${n}. Lasts for this fight.`
n => `Strength: attacks deal ${n} more damage.`
(n,u) => u.hero ? `Thorns: every enemy hit on this hero deals ${n} damage back to the attacker. Lasts until this hero's next turn.` : `Thorns: every time you hit it, you take ${n} damage.`
n => `Flame Armor: every enemy hit on this hero gives the attacker ${n} Burn. Lasts until this hero's next turn.`
n => `Ice Armor: every enemy hit on this hero gives the attacker ${n} Ice. Lasts until this hero's next turn.`
n => `Static Armor: every enemy hit on this hero deals 1–${n} damage back to the attacker. Lasts until this hero's next turn.`
n => `Blizzard: for ${n} more enemy turn${n>1?'s':''}, all enemies take damage and Ice at the start of the enemy turn.`
() => `Lifesteal: heals for all unblocked damage it deals.`
() => `Regrow: a destroyed part grows back after 3 turns unless all parts are destroyed at the same time.`
() => `Summoner: calls minions to fight. They flee when their master falls.`
() => `Hexer: shuffles Hex curses into every hero's discard pile. Each Hex in hand at the end of a hero's turn deals 3 damage to that hero.`
() => 'Soul Anvil (buff): at the start of each turn a random ally gets a Tailored Gift.'
n => `Corruption ${n}/100 (permanent): bonuses at 10 / 25 / 50 / 100. Sanity drains by ${Math.floor(n / 10)} per turn.`
(n, u) => u.hero ? 'Corrupted Mind: loses this turn and all Energy. Sanity is restored.' : 'Corrupted Mind: loses its next turn.'

n => `Dream ${n}/${dreamCap()}: ${n >= 7 ? 'takes 25% more damage and deals 25% less' : n >= 4 ? 'deals 25% less damage' : 'harmless for now'}. At 10: Nightmare – loses 20% of its max HP (bosses 10%).`
n => `Depth ${n}: used as a resource to summon creatures from the deep.`
n => `Abyssal Instincts (buff): every Servant he summons gains +${n} attack.`
n => `Abyssal Commander (buff): every Servant he summons gains +${n} attack.`
n => `Abyssal Mutation (buff): whenever a Servant attacks, it gains +${n} attack. Servants with 20+ attack attack twice at the end of his turn.`
() => `Heart of the Abyss (buff): whenever a Drowned Spawn attacks, it also deals 50% of its attack to ALL enemies.`
n => `The Awakening (buff): at 20 Depth he spends all of it and The Sleeping One appears for free (${n} damage to ALL enemies at the end of his turn).`
n => `Mark of the Deep (buff): whenever he gains Corruption, he gains ${n} Block.`
n => `Abyssal Binding (buff): whenever his Sanity hits 0, he gains ${n} Block.`
n => `Eldritch Restraint (buff): whenever his Sanity hits 0, he gains ${n} Power.`
n => `Regain Control (buff): at the start of his turn he gains ${n} Sanity and loses ${n} Corruption.`
() => `The Forbidden One (buff): all his cards have Vanish and deal +0.5% damage per Corruption (now +${Math.round(corruptionOf() * 0.5)}%).`

n => `Dream Eater (buff): Dream on enemies stacks up to 20 – Nightmare at 20, and Nightmares deal double damage. Reality Distortion steps are 6+, 12+ and 18+.${n >= 2 ? ' Draws 1 card whenever a Nightmare triggers.' : ''}`
n => `A Thousand Sleeping Eyes (buff): his attacks give enemies with Dream 1 more Dream. Whenever a Nightmare triggers, he draws 1 card${n >= 2 ? ' and gains 1 Energy' : ''}.`
n => `Embrace the Void (buff): whenever he loses Sanity, ALL enemies take ${n} damage.`
() => 'Fade: your next attack costs 1 less.'
n => `Shadow Investment: your next ${n} attack${n > 1 ? 's' : ''} deal extra damage per hit.`
n => `Golden Contract: your next attack deals +${n} damage per hit.`
n => `Assassination Window: your next Back Attack deals +${n}% damage.`
n => `Blood Catalyst: your next ${n} attack${n > 1 ? 's' : ''} apply Poison.`
n => `Riches to Power (buff): Greed grants +1 damage per hit for every 25 Gold (max +${n} at 500 Gold).`
n => `The Golden Empire (buff): +${n} Gold per card played; +1 damage per hit per 50 Gold, +${n} more at 200 Gold.`
n => `Self-Inflicted Mutation (buff): whenever Poison is applied to you, +${n} damage per hit for this fight.`
n => `Mutation: +${n} damage per hit (this fight).`
() => 'Mutated: your attacks deal double damage for the rest of the fight.'
n => `Venom Tolerance (buff): at the end of each round in which you are Poisoned, heal ${n} HP.`
n => `Hunter's Mark (buff): your Back Attacks deal ${n} more damage.`
n => `The Hour of Awakening (buff): at the start of each of your turns, deal ${n} damage to ALL enemies.`
n => `Plague Engine (buff): at the end of your turn, each Poisoned enemy gains ${n} Poison (+${n - 1} if you are Poisoned).`
n => `Heart of Venom (buff): poisoning an enemy poisons you by 1. At ${10 - 2 * (n - 2)} self-inflicted Poison: gain ${n} Energy and draw ${n}.`

n => `Death Sentence: the next ${n} attack${n > 1 ? 's' : ''} of the Executioner against it deal extra damage.`
n => `Hunter's Mark: Back Attacks of the Executioner deal +${n} damage to it this turn.`
n => `Toxic Amplifier: its next Poison tick deals +${n}% damage.`
n => `Empower: the next attack deals +${n} damage.`
n => `Veil: takes ${n}% less damage until your next turn.`

n => `Primordial Guardian: takes ${n}% less damage for a short time.`

n => `Celestial Immortality: ${n > 1 ? 'twice' : 'once'} per turn a single hit can't kill this hero – it stays at 1 HP.`
n => `Aegis of the Seraphim: prevents the next ${n} debuff${n > 1 ? 's' : ''}.`
n => `Astral Benediction: heals ${n}% max HP at the start of each turn; every 2nd heal-over-time tick heals ${n}% more.`
() => 'Starlight Constellation: some heal-over-time ticks heal 8 more.'
n => `Heal over Time: heals about ${n} HP at the start of each turn.`
n => `Radiant Burn: takes ${n} damage at the start of its turn (Wrath).`
n => `Thorn Armor: deals ${n} damage back to every attacker until your next turn.`
n => `Frost Armor: the next enemy that hits this hero gets ${n} Ice.`
n => `Fire Armor: the next enemy that hits this hero gets ${n} Burn.`
n => `Static Armor: the next enemy that hits this hero takes up to ${n} damage.`
